compound

- hip_extension

Fatigue Score:
2

low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- hip_extension_strength
- glute_activation_and_strengthening

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Hip Extension with Bands, force: push, level: beginner, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['glutes'], secondaryMuscles: ['hamstrings']

Substitution Options:

- name: Glute Bridge, equipment: none

Instructions:

- Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
- Facing the attachment point of the band, hold on to the column to stabilize yourself.
- Keeping your head and your chest up, move the resisted leg back as far as you can while keeping the knee straight.
- Return the leg to the starting position.
